failure_modes.label: Lube oil venting step omitted at startup
failure_modes.mechanism: Required step MNT-FW-022 Rev. 14 §4.3.2 omitted: lube oil reservoir not vented. Air pocket in lube oil system suppresses oil delivery to bearings from first rotation.

failure_modes.label: Lube oil cooler fouling — degraded cooling
failure_modes.mechanism: Deposits on lube oil cooler reduce heat transfer. Bearing temperature rises gradually over multiple start/run cycles.

failure_modes.label: Bearing end-of-life / intrinsic wear
failure_modes.mechanism: Extended operation beyond bearing life or degraded lubrication history. Last inspection 6 months prior found condition acceptable.

failure_modes.label: Procedure acceptance criterion gap — venting step
failure_modes.mechanism: MNT-FW-022 Rev. 14 §4.3.2 requires lube oil venting but provides no measurable acceptance criterion (no flow rate, no time window, no instrument readout). Procedural contributor independent of execution error.

failure_modes.label: Lube oil flow instrument bypass not restored
failure_modes.mechanism: U2-FT-LO-2201B placed in maintenance bypass during WO execution. Bypass not lifted prior to pump restart. Alarm inhibited: inadequate oil flow was undetected.
